This hearing has been done through hybrid mode.
CRL.M.A. 14404/2025 (delay)

2. The present application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act read with Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 482 of the Cr.P.C.) seeks condonation of delay of 12 days in filing the captioned appeal.

3. Since the Appellant has been in custody and the present appeal has been filed through the legal aid counsel, the delay of 12 days in filing the captioned appeal is hereby condoned.
4. Application is allowed and disposed of accordingly.
CRL.M.A. 14403/2025 (exemption)
5. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
Application is allowed and disposed of accordingly.

He shall further undergo simple imprisonment for a period of one month in default of payment of fine.

8. Admit.
9.
The Registry is directed to requisition the Trial Court Record with proper index, pagination and bookmarks for perusal of this Court by the next date of hearing.
Let the paperbook for the same be also prepared.
Let the TCR be tagged along with the present appeal.
Learned counsel for the parties may obtain the electronic record of the Court, including the TCR and the paper book, upon request from the Registry.

The present application under Section 430 read with Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 482 of the CrPC) seeks suspension of sentence and release of the appellant/applicant on bail during pendency of the instant appeal.
